rows.falsifier: Demonstration of path-independence in preference formation outcomes under arbitrary model misspecification.
rows.reason: New evidence from general preference oracle research (source-2d0bdfbb176d43bb) validates the structural distinction of learning regimes, reinforcing the path-dependence observation in misspecified model regimes.
rows.statement: The inferential path-dependence of preference formation models under misspecification constrains the stability of autonomous agents, supported by general preference oracle frameworks that decouple reward function assumptions from preference learning.
